title: Use Cell Selection to View Cell Code (Node Code) and Station/Workstation ID
summary: Use the OptiSweep map’s Cell Selection (QR code) view to click a map cell and read the displayed 8-digit cell code (node code / physical QR code number) for that location. For orange station cells, the UI also shows the workstation ID, which you can use to coordinate where to bring/push an AGB.
when_to_use: When you need the 8-digit cell code (node code / physical QR code number) for a map location, and when the selected cell is an orange station and you also need the workstation ID for coordination.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a replacement for physical verification of the QR code on the floor when the map/UI values are not showing the expected cell code or station/workstation ID.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the OptiSweep map in Cell Selection (QR code) mode, select the correct map cell, and extract the 8-digit cell code (node code). For orange station cells, also extract the workstation ID for operator coordination.
access_or_tools_needed: OptiSweep map UI with “cell selection” mode (QR code view)
Ability to click/select cells on the map
On-screen cell information display showing the 8-digit cell code and (for orange station cells) workstation ID

system_preconditions: The OptiSweep map view must have “cell selection” mode available/enabled (described as the QR code view).

visual_references.description: Cell Selection (QR code / node code) view showing: selecting a cell to view the 8-digit cell code; orange cells representing stations; orange station selection showing additional workstation ID (example station ID 862).

steps.title: Open the map view where “cell selection” is available (QR code view)
steps.purpose: Get to the UI mode that displays the QR code / node code (cell code) when a map cell is selected.
steps.instruction: Open the OptiSweep map view and switch to the “cell selection” view (described as the QR code view).
steps.expected_result: The map is in Cell Selection (QR code) mode so that clicking a cell will display cell information including the QR code / node code.
steps.healthy_condition: Selecting a cell in the map produces an on-screen cell information display that includes an 8-digit value.
steps.failure_condition: The UI does not show cell information (including the 8-digit cell code) after selecting a cell, indicating Cell Selection mode may not be enabled.

actions.label: Enable Cell Selection (QR code) mode
actions.exact_action: Open the map view where “cell selection” is available (the cell selection view is described as the QR code view).

steps.title: Select a cell on the map to view the cell information (QR code / node code)
steps.purpose: Trigger the UI overlay/panel that shows the QR code / node code (cell code) for the chosen location.
steps.instruction: In Cell Selection mode, click/select the target cell on the map to display its cell information including the QR code.
steps.expected_result: The UI shows cell information for the selected map cell, including an 8-digit number.
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking a cell, the cell information panel/overlay appears and includes an 8-digit value.
steps.failure_condition: After selecting a cell, the cell information panel/overlay does not appear or does not include an 8-digit value.

actions.label: Click/select the target map cell
actions.exact_action: In cell selection mode, click/select a cell on the map to view the cell information including the QR code.

steps.title: Read the 8-digit cell code (node code / physical QR code number)
steps.purpose: Extract the unique 8-digit identifier for the selected location so it can be used for coordination (e.g., directing an operator to bring/push an AGB to that cell).
steps.instruction: From the selected cell’s information, read the displayed 8-digit number and record it as the cell code (node code / physical QR code number) for that location.
steps.expected_result: You have an 8-digit cell code (node code / physical QR code number) corresponding to the selected map location.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI displays an 8-digit number for the selected cell, and it is treated as the unique cell code for that location.
steps.failure_condition: The selected cell does not show an 8-digit cell code in the cell information display.

actions.label: Record the displayed 8-digit cell code
actions.exact_action: Read the displayed 8-digit number; treat it as the cell code (also called node code) for that location.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the selected cell does not show the expected 8-digit cell code, stop and escalate for assistance (no troubleshooting steps are provided in the source).

steps.title: If the selected cell is an orange station, confirm and record the workstation ID
steps.purpose: Obtain the station/workstation ID associated with orange station cells for more precise coordination.
steps.instruction: Check whether the selected cell is an orange cell (station). If it is orange, confirm the UI shows an additional workstation ID value along with the QR/cell code, and record that workstation ID.
steps.expected_result: For an orange station cell, the UI shows both the 8-digit cell code and an additional workstation ID value (example given: station ID 862).
steps.healthy_condition: The selected orange cell displays the workstation ID field/value in addition to the 8-digit cell code.
steps.failure_condition: For an orange station cell, the UI does not show the workstation ID value.

actions.label: Verify orange station and capture workstation ID
actions.exact_action: If the selected cell is an orange cell (station), confirm that the UI shows an additional “workstation ID” value along with the QR/cell code.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the selected cell is an orange station and it does not show the expected workstation ID, stop and escalate for assistance (no troubleshooting steps are provided in the source).

steps.title: Use the cell code (and workstation ID when applicable) to coordinate AGB movement
steps.purpose: Translate the extracted identifiers into an operator-facing instruction for where to bring/push an AGB.
steps.instruction: If operator coordination is needed, use the recorded cell code to ask the operator to bring/push the AGB to that cell (example format given: “bring the AGB to cell … like 12345678”). If you recorded a workstation ID for an orange station cell, include it as part of the station reference as needed for coordination.
steps.expected_result: The operator receives a clear cell reference using the 8-digit cell code (node code / physical QR code number) for the target location.
steps.healthy_condition: The cell code used in the coordination message matches the 8-digit value shown in the Cell Selection cell information for the selected map cell.
steps.failure_condition: The coordination message uses a value that does not match the 8-digit cell code shown for the selected cell.

actions.label: Provide operator coordination using the cell code
actions.exact_action: Use the cell code to ask the operator to bring/push the AGB to that cell (example given: “bring the AGB to cell … like 12345678”).

success_criteria: You can select a map cell in Cell Selection (QR code) mode and observe an 8-digit cell code (node code / physical QR code number) for that location.
When the selected cell is an orange station cell, you can also observe and record the workstation ID shown by the UI.
healthy_conditions: Cell Selection mode is enabled and clicking a cell displays cell information including an 8-digit number.
The 8-digit cell code is treated as a unique identifier for the location (no multiple values for a cell code).
Orange station cells show an additional workstation ID value.
failure_conditions: Selected cell does not show the expected 8-digit cell code.
Selected orange station cell does not show the workstation ID value.
escalation_guidance: If the selected cell does not show the expected 8-digit cell code, stop and escalate for assistance (the source provides no troubleshooting steps).
If the selected cell is an orange station and it does not show the workstation ID, stop and escalate for assistance (the source provides no troubleshooting steps).
